 Introduction 
 Patrick 
My guest today is Mark Groden. Mark is the Founder and CEO of Skyryse, a company on a mission to make general aviation as safe as commercial aviation and change the future of flying. If you're interested in flying in any way, I think you'll be engrossed in this one.

 Sometimes when learning about companies, it's hard for me to figure out their mission or what exactly they really want to accomplish. When I visited Skyryse in L.A. as part of an investment I made in the business, I've never seen a mission so clearly stated and supported. In their case, to bring deaths in general aviation helicopters and planes to 0.

 As you'll hear, Mark was born to do this specific job, clearly, a person doing their life's work. I'm blown away every time I talk with him by his command of the details and by his obsession with flying. With the many scary recent helicopter crashes, I think understanding the past and future of these and other noncommercial jet aircraft is timely and important.
